race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +10% In October Mdn Plate
race.comment: Anything but your run-of-the-mill 3YO provincial maiden with no shortage of debutants from top stables who have impressed at the jumpouts. It'd be a shock if a few of them didn't turn out to be metro class. Siding with the Freedmans' Wootton Bassett colt STRIKE PACKAGE (3) who looked good in his latest jumpout at Caulfield when he finished stylishly under a light ride before being eased up late. Mark Zahra rode there and this is his only ride for the night. Home Affairs gelding SPLENDACIOUS (2) has finished second at his last two jumpouts and caught the eye finishing hard from the back in the latest. The inside alley should help him hold a spot. CALL ME LATER (5) unraced 3yo filly who has trialled six times. Impressive trial win on September 22 at Pakenham over 800m. Include. FRONT PAGE EDITION (7) three-year-old filly out of the Stakes performer Written Dash. Runner up in recent jumpout. Wary.
